summary.text: A patient in their forties presented with a week of painless swelling over one elbow, warm to the touch, with no injury. Olecranon bursitis was suspected and rest with anti-inflammatory treatment agreed.

reflection.happened: Reassured too quickly before checking for infection.
reflection.learned: Warmth over a bursa needs a temperature and a look for a portal of entry.
reflection.next: Add a red-flag check to my bursitis consultations.
